steps.description:
- The setting fades in to reveal the nameless boy sleeping on the ground.
- The boy wakes up in the midst of Limbo world.

- Proceed forth toward the edge of the tree branch.
- Drop yourself down the cliff, where the inclined slope safely lets you slide down.

- Beware of the deadly obstacle: jump over the spiky hole to avoid impaling yourself.
- Then move to cross the next checkpoint/chapter.

callouts.title: Hidden Egg
callouts.text:
- The hidden egg is found right at the start of the game.
- Move to the leftmost part of the game and obtain the egg on the paddle.
- This gains the "Wrong Way" achievement.
